intro: The Rite of Strength is the initial trial in the traditional Rites of the Earthmother undertaken by young tauren at Camp Narache. To demonstrate their bravery and defense of the tribe, initiates must cull encroaching Bristleback quilboar in Brambleblade Ravine and present their belts to Chief Hawkwind.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: The Rites of the Earthmother are the steps a young tauren needs to take to gain respect in Thunder Bluff.
First you must pass the Rite of Strength. In this test you must prove your bravery by slaying enemies of the tribe.
Bristlebacks of Brambleblade Ravine to the east are encroaching on our tribal lands. They ambush our hunting parties and steal from the village by dark.
Show your valor by slaying these villains and return to the Chief in Camp Narache with their belts as proof of your deeds.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Have you completed the Rite of Strength, friend? I require proof of your valor against the enemy of our tribe, the Bristlebacks.

clips.title: Completion
paras: You have passed the first test of the Rites of the Earthmother. The tribe will be proud.
